doc: Stands in for saves/tech_double.state, by its own provenance (a splice of com_jogo_salvo.state) from the recipe-made com_jogo_salvo: party $2980-$2982 = 00 01 02 (Crono, Marle, Lucca); Marle knows Aura ($2838 = 80) and the Crono+Marle pair Aura Whirl ($283E = 80); Marle at 20/20 MP ($2657, $2659); Crono wounded ($2603 = 10) -- a dual tech list reachable in the X menu.
